text:
jamie: quick flag toops observed a burst of short ws reconnect loops in eu-central after the proxy push. small latency blip but big reconnect count spike. quota meters look flat. anyone seen this?

ravi: which metric are you watching, `ws.session_reconnects` or `ws.reconnect_events`? dashboards split them.

jamie: `ws.session_reconnects` live panel. query: `sum(rate(ws.session_reconnects[5m])) by (route)` — pattern shows 200% increase for route /v1/stream.

zoe: proxy v2 added an auth-refresh path that closes sockets aggressively and triggers SDK retries. logs show same resume_token across the rapid reconnects. telemetry currently tags by `conn_fd` so each handshake counts separately. that explains meter vs billing mismatch.

mike: logs also show same resume_token but different conn_fd; ingestion treats those as distinct events. billing uses resume_token dedupe and stays flat.

jamie: ok, mitigation? Ops page is noisy.

ravi: temp fix: mute the P1 alert on `ws.session_reconnects` and create a temp alert on `billing.resume_successes` with a higher threshold. I'll open PR to swap and annotate the chart.

zoe: medium term: emit a stable `reconnect_id` derived from `resume_token` + 30s time bucket so proxy-induced duplicates collapse. sample implementation: ```python
key = f"{resume_token}|{int(client_ts/30)}"
reconnect_id = sha256(key)[:12]
metrics.count('ws.reconnect', 1, tags={'reconnect_id': reconnect_id, 'phase': phase})
```

mike: telemetry pipeline drops new high-card tags by default. I'll file infra ticket PLAT-4087 to allow `reconnect_id` through for 48h and update hypertable index.

ops-bot: deploy-note: edge-proxy v2 rolled to eu-central at 03:07 UTC. rollout_id=rl-2026-03-23-09.

jamie: product note: don't flip global reconnect panel until dedupe is live. product: can we surface an "experimental deduped" panel instead?

product: yes, add "reconnect_dedupe_v1" panel flagged experimental. we will include tooltip: 'counts deduped by resume token; historical numbers unchanged'. include small release note.

ravi: rollout plan: feature flag `stable_reconnect_id`, start eu-central 100% (hot path) and eu-west 0%. Compare `reconnect_dedupe_v1`/`ws.session_reconnects` ratio for 6h; require ratio > 0.9 to consider global flip. also add `reconnect_phase` tag to separate client retries vs server retries.

zoe: SDK change: throttle client retries in first 10s to avoid storm and fallback for old clients with no resume_token to `client_id|ip|tsbucket`. will log warnings for fallback.

mike: I'll add the compare panel and the dedupe ratio metric; will also coordinate pipeline migration windows. PLAT-4087 and PLAT-4088 created.

jamie: owners: jamie -> ops playbook + console panel, ravi -> alert change + PR, zoe -> metric emission + SDK guard, mike -> infra pipeline + index. I'll post the short runbook in the incident doc and keep the canary in eu-central until ratio stabilizes.

ops-bot: alert muted: ws_reconnect_surge (muted by ravi for 2h).

jamie: thanks all, ping if you need help with the PR or rollbacks.
